alerts.title: Notice
alerts.toMsec: Change the oscilloscope time scale to msec before using Single Stimulus.
alerts.toSec: Change the oscilloscope time scale to seconds before using Multiple Stimulus.
alerts.minToMsec: Change the oscilloscope time scale to msec for a single stimulus, or increase the Interval between Stimuli for repeated stimuli.
alerts.msecToMin: Change the oscilloscope time scale to minutes for repeated stimuli, or set the Interval between Stimuli to zero for a single stimulus.
alerts.clean: Please clean the nerve before you continue.
alerts.squirm: Apply ethanol to the worm before placing it in the chamber.
alerts.ethanol: You have already applied ethanol to the worm.
alerts.noNerve: Drag a nerve to the chamber before stimulating.
alerts.bioAmp: Turn on the Bio-Amplifier before stimulating.
alerts.dataFull: Unless you clear a line of data from the table you won't have room to record any measurements.
alerts.heatFirst: Place the glass bar on the Heater and click Heat.

hints.drag: Drag to the nerve (or click) to apply
hints.dragNerve: Drag to the chamber (or click) to place the nerve; click again to remove it
hints.dragBar: Drag the bar to the nerve to stimulate it, or to the heater to heat it
hints.measure: Move the measuring line with the arrows to the start of the action potential.
